sources.entry: Mooziac - Lightweight native macOS menu bar player for YouTube Music and local audio with trackpad gestures.

summary.one_liner: Mooziac is a native Swift/AppKit macOS app that plays YouTube Music from the menu bar, runs a YouTube video window with VideoToolbox decoding, and plays local audio files.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a menu bar player for YouTube Music streams and a separate native window for YouTube videos, with VideoToolbox hardware decoding and SponsorBlock auto-skip. Includes trackpad edge gestures for volume and track control, plus keyboard shortcuts for music and video modes. Shows a floating synchronized LRC lyrics HUD, cached in SQLite, and an AVFoundation offline player for FLAC, ALAC, WAV, MP3, AAC, and M4A files. Offers Discord Rich Presence over a Unix socket, M3U8/JSON playlist import and export, and a yt-dlp-based downloader. The README says it is built with zero third-party runtime dependencies and stores history and likes locally with no telemetry.
use_cases: Stream YouTube Music in the macOS menu bar
Watch YouTube videos in a native 4K player window
Skip sponsor segments in YouTube videos
Play local FLAC or ALAC music files offline
Show synced song lyrics while listening
notable: Native Swift and AppKit with no Electron or Chromium, per the README
Invisible trackpad edge slider for volume with haptic feedback
SponsorBlock auto-skip built into the video player
Synced LRC lyrics HUD backed by LRCLib and a local SQLite cache
Discord Rich Presence over a native Unix socket
caveats: Direct-download builds are not notarized, so Gatekeeper may need manual approval or an xattr command
Trackpad gestures depend on the MacBook trackpad hardware
